_source: Captured from the tools/list payload built by murmur8 9989c0d5 McpToolFactory (ExposedToolNames order), 2026-09-25. Regenerate after any murmur8 tool-schema change (the 2026-06-26 capture had drifted: no revision/clearFields/remindAt, 16 of 18 tools).

tools.name: list
tools.description: List entities of a given type. Returns { results, nextCursor }. Pass nextCursor to fetch the next page; null means end of list.

cursor.description: Pagination token from a previous response's nextCursor. Omit for first page.

pageSize.description: Number of rows per page (max 100). Default 20.

createdAfter.description: ISO 8601 UTC. Filters by entity creation time. Applies to types with CreatedAt: tasks, task_lists, task_comments, task_list_members, files, directories, albums, photos, share_links, calendars, calendar_members, event_attendees, feed_sources, feed_subscriptions, emails. Ignored on types without CreatedAt.

createdBefore.description: ISO 8601 UTC. Filters by entity creation time. See createdAfter.

updatedAfter.description: ISO 8601 UTC. Filters by entity last-update time. Applies to types with UpdatedAt: tasks, files, albums, calendars.

updatedBefore.description: ISO 8601 UTC. Filters by entity last-update time. See updatedAfter.

status.description: Filter by status. For tasks (NeedsAction/InProcess/Completed/Cancelled): defaults to active tasks (excludes Completed/Cancelled), which works account-wide. 'All'/'Completed'/'Cancelled' return whole-board history and REQUIRE a taskListId (one board at a time). For reminders (Pending/Fired/Dismissed/Cancelled): defaults to Pending (upcoming). Pass 'All' to include every status.

taskListId.description: Filter by task list ID. Required for: task_list_members; tasks when status is All/Completed/Cancelled. Optional for: tasks with active/no status.

taskId.description: Filter by task ID. Required for: task_comments, task_links.

directoryId.description: Filter by directory ID. Optional for: files.

parentDirectoryId.description: Filter by parent directory ID. Omit to list root directories. Optional for: directories.

calendarId.description: Calendar ID. Optional for: calendar_events. Required for: calendar_members.

eventId.description: Calendar event ID. Required for: event_attendees.

start.description: Range start as ISO 8601 UTC (e.g. 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z). Optional for: calendar_events; defaults to now, so past events are hidden unless you pass an earlier start.

end.description: Range end as ISO 8601 UTC. Optional for: calendar_events; defaults to 7 days after start. Response includes truncated:true if the 50-occurrence cap was hit; narrow the range in that case.

createdBy.description: Filter by creator user ID. Applies to: tasks.

updatedBy.description: Filter by last editor user ID. Applies to: tasks.

parentTaskId.description: Filter by parent task ID to list subtasks. Applies to: tasks.

category.description: Filter by category. Applies to: feed_articles, feed_subscriptions.

folderId.description: Filter by email folder ID. Applies to: emails, email_threads.

starred.description: Filter to starred only. Applies to: emails, email_threads.

unread.description: Filter to unread only. Applies to: emails, email_threads.

isRead.description: Filter by read state. Applies to: feed_articles. Defaults to unread (false) when omitted; pass true to list already-read articles.

isBookmarked.description: Filter to bookmarked only. Applies to: feed_articles.

isSubscribed.description: Filter to subscribed feeds only. Applies to: feed_sources.

publishedAfter.description: ISO 8601 UTC. Filters by published time. Applies to: feed_articles.

dateAfter.description: ISO 8601 UTC. Filters by message Date (sent/received). Applies to: emails.

lastActivityAfter.description: ISO 8601 UTC. Filters by thread's last message date. Applies to: email_threads.

addedAfter.description: ISO 8601 UTC. Filters by AddedAt. Applies to: task_list_members.

tools.name: get
tools.description: Get the full details of a single entity by its ID.

id.description: The unique identifier of the entity. Required for all types.

occurrenceDate.description: For calendar_event with a recurring master: ISO 8601 UTC occurrence date to resolve a specific instance (e.g. 2026-04-13T14:00:00Z). Omit to get the master row.

tools.name: create
tools.description: Create a new entity of the specified type.

title.description: Title. Required for: task, reminder, calendar_event. For these, 'name' is accepted as an alias.

name.description: Display name. Required for: task_list, directory, album, calendar.

taskListId.description: Task list ID. Required for: task, task_list_member.

username.description: Username to add as member. Required for: task_list_member, calendar_member. Optional for: event_attendee.

albumId.description: Album ID. Required for: album_photo, album_member.

fileItemId.description: File ID. Required for: album_photo. Optional for: share_link.

memberUserId.description: User ID to add as member. Required for: album_member.

description.description: Detailed description. Use for any context beyond a short title — user-provided detail, specifications, sub-items. Strongly recommended when the user provides rich text. Applies to: task, album, calendar, calendar_event. Supports annotations: @[DisplayName](user:userId) for user mentions, #[DisplayName](EntityType:entityId) for entity references (e.g. #[README.md](FileItem:abc-123)).

priority.description: Priority from 0 (undefined) to 9 (lowest). 1 = highest. Optional for: task.

dueDate.description: Due date as ISO 8601 (e.g. 2026-03-15T00:00:00Z). Optional for: task.

parentTaskId.description: Parent task ID to create a subtask. Optional for: task. Max 1 level deep (cannot create a subtask of a subtask).

tags.description: Tag list. Optional for: task. Call get_task_tags first to reuse existing tags and maintain consistent casing.

parentDirectoryId.description: Parent directory ID. Omit for root. Optional for: directory.

permission.description: Permission level (View/Edit/Share/Admin). Optional for: task_list_member (defaults to Edit), album_member (defaults to View). Required for: calendar_member.

directoryId.description: Directory ID to share. Optional for: share_link (provide fileItemId or directoryId).

expiresAt.description: Expiration date as ISO 8601. Optional for: share_link.

maxDownloads.description: Maximum download count. Optional for: share_link.

eventId.description: Calendar event ID. Required for: event_attendee.

calendarId.description: Calendar ID. Required for: calendar_event, calendar_member.

startTime.description: Start date-time as local time WITHOUT timezone offset or Z suffix (e.g. 2026-03-15T22:30:00). The timezone is provided separately via the timeZone parameter. Required for: calendar_event.

endTime.description: End date-time as local time WITHOUT timezone offset or Z suffix (e.g. 2026-03-15T23:30:00). The timezone is provided separately via the timeZone parameter. Required for: calendar_event.

timeZone.description: IANA timezone (e.g. America/New_York). Required for: calendar_event.

rrule.description: RRULE recurrence string. Optional for: calendar_event.

isAllDay.description: All-day event flag. Optional for: calendar_event.

color.description: Hex color code. Required for: calendar.

icsUrl.description: Public iCalendar (.ics) feed URL. Required for: calendar_subscription.

syncIntervalMinutes.description: How often to re-sync the subscription, in minutes (minimum 60, default 1440). Optional for: calendar_subscription.

feedSourceId.description: Feed source ID. Required for: feed_subscription.

feedUrl.description: RSS/Atom feed URL. Required for: custom_feed.

category.description: Category for the feed (e.g. Technology, World News). Optional for: custom_feed.

note.description: Optional longer note body. Optional for: reminder.

remindAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC datetime. Required for: reminder.

originalInput.description: Original natural language phrasing. Optional for: reminder.

sourceTaskId.description: Source task ID. Required for: task_link. For Parent it is the parent task; for Blocks it is the blocking task.

targetTaskId.description: Target task ID. Required for: task_link. For Parent it is the child task; for Blocks it is the blocked task.

linkType.description: Relationship kind. Required for: task_link. Parent = subtask, Blocks = source blocks target, Related = soft link. For 'blocked by', swap source/target and use Blocks.

tools.name: update
tools.description: Update an existing entity. Only provided fields are changed.

taskListId.description: Task list ID. Required for: task_list.

directoryId.description: Directory ID. Required for: directory. Optional for: file (move file to directory).

albumId.description: Album ID. Required for: album, album_photos, active_album.

text.description: Updated text content. Required for: task_comment.

name.description: Display name. Optional for: task_list, file, directory, album, calendar.

description.description: Detailed description. Use for any context beyond a short title — user-provided detail, specifications, sub-items. Strongly recommended when the user provides rich text. Applies to: task, album, calendar, calendar_event. Supports annotations: @[DisplayName](user:userId) for user mentions, #[DisplayName](EntityType:entityId) for entity references (e.g. #[README.md](FileItem:abc-123)).

status.description: Status value. Optional for: task (NeedsAction=to do, InProcess=in progress, Completed=done, Cancelled=cancelled), calendar_event (Confirmed, Tentative, Cancelled). Use internal values here, friendly names when talking to user.

priority.description: Priority from 0 (undefined) to 9 (lowest). 1 = highest. Optional for: task.

dueDate.description: Due date as ISO 8601 (e.g. 2026-03-15T00:00:00Z). Optional for: task.

tags.description: Tag list. Optional for: task. Call get_task_tags first to reuse existing tags and maintain consistent casing.

parentDirectoryId.description: Move to parent directory. Optional for: directory.

coverPhotoId.description: Cover photo file ID. Optional for: album.

fileItemIds.description: Ordered list of file IDs for reordering. Required for: album_photos.

expiresInHours.description: Hours until active album expires. Optional for: active_album.

calendarSubscriptionId.description: Calendar subscription ID. Required for: calendar_subscription.

syncIntervalMinutes.description: Re-sync frequency in minutes (minimum 60). Optional for: calendar_subscription.

eventId.description: Calendar event ID. Required for: calendar_event.

startTime.description: Start date-time as local time WITHOUT timezone offset or Z suffix (e.g. 2026-03-15T22:30:00). The timezone is provided separately via the timeZone parameter. Optional for: calendar_event.

endTime.description: End date-time as local time WITHOUT timezone offset or Z suffix (e.g. 2026-03-15T23:30:00). The timezone is provided separately via the timeZone parameter. Optional for: calendar_event.

timeZone.description: IANA timezone (e.g. America/New_York). Optional for: calendar_event.

rrule.description: RRULE recurrence string. Optional for: calendar_event.

isAllDay.description: All-day event flag. Optional for: calendar_event.

color.description: Hex color code. Optional for: calendar.

editMode.description: For calendar_event recurring series (case-insensitive). AllEvents (default) edits the whole series, ThisEvent edits only the occurrence on occurrenceDate, ThisAndFuture edits that occurrence and all after.

occurrenceDate.description: ISO 8601 UTC occurrence date. Required when editMode is ThisEvent or ThisAndFuture.

emailMessageId.description: Email message ID. Required for: email.

isRead.description: Mark email as read (true) or unread (false). Optional for: email.

toggleStar.description: Toggle the starred state of the email. Optional for: email.

remindAt.description: New reminder time, UTC ISO 8601 with a Z suffix (e.g. 2026-06-26T22:00:00Z). Optional for: reminder.

revision.description: Expected current revision of the entity (from a prior read); the write is rejected if the entity changed since. Required for revisioned entity types: task, task_list, task_comment, file, directory, album, calendar, calendar_event, reminder. Obtain it from a get for entities that support get; for reminder and task_comment (which have no get), the list result carries the revision — read it from there.

clearFields.description: Field names to reset to empty (null / 0 / empty list). Valid names by type — task: dueDate, startDate, priority, percentComplete, description, tags, assignee; calendar_event: description, location, url, rrule; calendar: description; album: description, coverPhoto; reminder: note, linkedTask; file: directory; directory: parent. You cannot list a field you are also setting in the same call.

tools.name: delete
tools.description: Delete an entity of the specified type.

linkId.description: Task link ID. Required for: task_link.

taskListId.description: Task list ID. Required for: task_list.

memberId.description: Membership ID. Required for: task_list_member, calendar_member.

albumId.description: Album ID. Required for: album, album_photo, album_member.

fileItemId.description: File item ID. Required for: album_photo.

memberUserId.description: User ID of the member to remove. Required for: album_member.

shareLinkId.description: Share link ID. Required for: share_link.

fileShareId.description: File share ID. Required for: file_share.

eventId.description: Calendar event ID. Required for: calendar_event.

editMode.description: For calendar_event recurring series (case-insensitive). AllEvents (default) deletes the whole series, ThisEvent deletes only the occurrence on occurrenceDate, ThisAndFuture deletes that occurrence and all after.

occurrenceDate.description: ISO 8601 UTC occurrence date. Required when editMode is ThisEvent or ThisAndFuture.

attendeeId.description: Event attendee ID. Required for: event_attendee.

feedSubscriptionId.description: Feed subscription ID. Required for: feed_subscription.

calendarSubscriptionId.description: Calendar subscription ID. Required for: calendar_subscription.

feedSourceId.description: Feed source ID. Required for: custom_feed.

emailMessageId.description: Email message ID. Required for: email.

folderId.description: Email folder ID. Required for: email_folder.

revision.description: Expected current revision of the entity (from a prior read); the write is rejected if the entity changed since. Required for revisioned entity types: task, task_list, task_comment, file, directory, album, calendar, calendar_event, calendar_subscription, feed_subscription, reminder, share_link, task_link. Obtain it from a get for entities that support get; for reminder and task_comment (which have no get), the list result carries the revision — read it from there.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search across all domains (tasks, task lists, files, directories, calendar events, calendars, albums) with fuzzy text matching. Use this to find entities by name, title, or description.

query.description: Search text. Supports fuzzy matching — 'Jenn' will match 'Jennifer'.

types.description: Comma-separated entity types to filter results: TaskItem, TaskList, CalendarEvent, Calendar, FileItem, DirectoryItem, Album. Omit to search all types.

tools.name: get_task_tags
tools.description: Return the user's distinct tags across all tasks. Call this before creating or updating tasks with tags to reuse existing tags and maintain consistent casing.

tools.name: rank_focus_tasks
tools.description: Return the user's active tasks ranked by what to focus on next, each with a short reason. Set briefingScope to true to restrict to briefing-worthy tasks (assigned to the user, due-dated, or high-priority).

briefingScope.description: Restrict to briefing-worthy tasks (assigned to the user, due-dated, or high-priority).

dueBeforeUtc.description: UTC cutoff for the due-dated arm of the briefing scope. Ignored unless briefingScope is true.

tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: Upload a file from base64-encoded content. Creates the file in the user's storage, optionally in a specific directory.

name.description: Filename with extension (e.g. 'report.pdf', 'photo.jpg'). Used for display and MIME type detection.

mimeType.description: MIME type override. Auto-detected from filename extension if omitted.

directoryId.description: Target directory ID. Omit to place file in user's root.

tags.description: Tags to apply to the file.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send a new email from the user's mailbox. Specify recipients, subject, and body.

to.description: List of recipient email addresses. Required.

cc.description: List of CC email addresses. Optional.

bcc.description: List of BCC email addresses. Optional.

bodyHtml.description: HTML email body. Optional — provide for rich formatting.

tools.name: reply_to_email
tools.description: Reply to an existing email message. Automatically builds To/Cc lists from the original message.

originalMessageId.description: ID of the email message to reply to. Required.

bodyHtml.description: HTML reply body. Optional — provide for rich formatting.

isReplyAll.description: Reply to all recipients (true) or just the sender (false). Defaults to false.

tools.name: forward_email
tools.description: Forward an existing email message to new recipients. Includes original message headers and content.

originalMessageId.description: ID of the email message to forward. Required.

to.description: List of recipient email addresses. Required.

cc.description: List of CC email addresses. Optional.

bodyText.description: Plain text body to prepend to the forwarded message. Required.

bodyHtml.description: HTML body to prepend to the forwarded message. Optional.

tools.name: summarize_email_thread
tools.description: Summarize an email thread. Returns AI-generated summaries of each message and an overall thread summary. Use this to quickly understand long email conversations.

threadId.description: Email thread ID to summarize. Required.

tools.name: get_user_preferences
tools.description: Get the user's personal preferences and profile information. Returns preferences grouped by category: identity (name, sign-off), communication (writing tone, agent output style), schedule (dinner time, work hours), family (spouse, children, pets), interests (hobbies, favorite food), agenda (daily_closer). Use this to personalize emails, messages, and responses. Optionally filter by category.

category.description: Filter to a specific category. Valid values: identity, communication, schedule, family, interests, agenda. Omit to get all preferences.

tools.name: set_user_preferences
tools.description: Save or update the user's personal preferences. Use when the user shares personal information like their name, writing style, family members, hobbies, or daily routine. Categories: identity, communication, schedule, family, interests, agenda.

category.description: Category: identity, communication, schedule, family, interests, agenda.

tools.name: list_notifications
tools.description: List the current user's active notifications. Optionally filter by notification type. Returns up to 50 notifications ordered by creation date (newest first).

type.description: Filter by notification type. Omit for all types.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Clamped to 50.

tools.name: snooze_reminder
tools.description: Snooze a fired reminder for the specified number of minutes (default 15).

minutes.description: Number of minutes to snooze (1-1440, default 15).

tools.name: dismiss_reminder
tools.description: Dismiss a fired reminder so it disappears from the user's notification drawer.
